pārampariya.p: [ pārampara + ṇiya ] (ti) Google Translate (1) Successive. (2) The (method) taught by successive teachers.

R:
pārampariya：ပါရမ္ပရိယ （န） （ပါရမ္ပယ）
ထုံးတမ်းစဉ်လာ။ နည်းဥပဒေ။
DOP: pārampariya n. [ S. pāramparya], traditional instruction, tradition; Abh 412 (~am etihyam upadeso).

R:
paramparabhojana：ပရမ္ပရ-ဘောဇန （န）
အထပ်ထပ် သုံးဆောင်ခံစားခြင်း။ ရှေးဖိတ်အပ်သောဆွမ်းမှ နောက်ဖိတ်အပ်သော ဆွမ်းကို စားခြင်း။
DOP: parampara mfn. , ~ā, f. [ ts ], 1. ( mfn. ) one following the other, proceeding from one to another; ~aṃ, adv. , successively; Ap 7, 25 (paccekabuddhānaṃ samāgatānaṃ ~aṃ vyākaraṇāni yāni, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee paramparavyākaraṇāni; Ap-a 129, 25 : yāni apadānāni ~aṃ paccekaṃ vyākaraṇāni, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee yāni ~ā paccekasaṅkhyā vyākaraṇāni); Sp 1349, 31* (~aṃ ca bhojanaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~ā); — 2. (paramparā, f. ) an uninterrupted series; order, succession; tradition; M II 78, 9 (rañño … Makhādevassa puttapaputtakā tassa ~ā caturāsītikhattiyasahassāni; Ps III 312, 14 : puttā ca puttaputtā cā ti evaṃ pavattā tassa ~ā); A I 189, 8 (mā anussavena mā ~āya mā itikirāya …; Mp II 305, 17 : paramparakathāya pi mā gaṇhittha); Ja IV 35, 17* (na idha kadāci atthi ~ā nāma kule imasmiṃ); Sp 1304, 6 (yāya ~āya ānītaṃ taṃ dassetuṃ Upāli dasako cā ti ādinā nayena porāṇakehi mahātherehi gāthāyo ṭhapitā); Ps I 69, 13 (attano ~aṃ kaṅkhati); Mp II 273, 19 (ācariyaparamparā laddhiparamparā attabhāvaparamparā ti etesu yaṃ kiñci ~aṃ gantvā pi); Mhv 3:40 (theriyāyaṃ ~ā); — ifc see ācariya-, āvāsa-, puttanatta- ( sv putta ), yuga-, laddhi-; — ~āya, ~ā, adv., in succession, in order; proceeding from one to another; M II 73, 30* (saṃsāraṃ āpajja ~āya) = Th 785; Ja IV 369, 30 (piṇḍapāto ~ā yathānucchavikaṃ gacchati); V 235, 27 (mahāsatto ~āya taṃ pavattiṃ sutvā); Mil 276, 4 (anupubbena tassa kittisaddo ~āya ajj’ etarahi idha amhākaṃ samayaṃ anuppatto); Sp 190, 30 (bahūni ca nesaṃ sāvakayugāni ~āya brahmacariyaṃ pavattesuṃ); Sv 1035, 23 (evaṃ ~āya yāva brahmalokā); — (parampara)- bhojana , n. [ BHS id. ], eating in succession, going from one meal to another; (in effect, eating another meal before the one to which one has been invited); Vin IV 77, 8 (~e pācittiyan ti; 78, 14 : pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññatarena bhojanena nimantito taṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññataraṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjati etaṃ ~aṃ nāma); V 18, 17 ; Kkh 2 177, 8 (~e ti … yena yena paṭhamaṃ nimantito tassa tassa bhojanato uppaṭipāṭiyā vā avikappetvā vā parassa parassa bhojane); 178, 1 (~-tā); — (paramparā)- saṃsatta , mfn. , joined together in a line; D I 239, 25 (andhaveṇi ~ā, Ee so; Be, Se parampara-; Ce paramparaṃ-; Sv 401, 22 foll.: aññamaññaṃ laggā, yaṭṭhigāhakena pi cakkhumatā virahitā ti attho) ≠ M II 170, 16 ( eds so; Ps III 425, 14 , Be, Se = Sv; Ce, Ee aññamaññalaggayaṭṭhigāhakena pi cakkhumatā viharitā ti attho).
